purpose: Resolve the practical value and real cost of frozen SIMPLEX-T alternatives before any further training or promotion.
authorization_note: This file records a plan requested by the user; it does not start a new execution window, profiling run, training campaign, promotion, or sealed evaluation.
findings: H16 improves all three paired head seeds; the two new seeds have hierarchical CI95 [-5.244259454753143, 0.04109148518456987], so independent-scene evidence remains uncertain.
All three expert reductions fail the fixed accuracy screen, including sign and crucial-bucket limits.
SET_AGE and SET_NOTIME fail the fixed hierarchical-CI precision screen; this is not proof that all pooling or time-free models are inferior.
Primary and replay head timings differ materially; their cause is not isolated. No causal expert-removal or end-to-end speed claim is justified.
OBneIVg4Cw has positive H16-minus-H8 loss delta in all three seeds; this is a diagnostic lead, not a reason to exclude it.
The nine independent sequences, frozen experts and reused OLD_DEV remain the limitations; additional head seeds would not create new scenes or replicate expert training.

single_next_study.name: Frozen-system accuracy/cost and failure characterization

stages.task: Consolidate final evidence and comparator admission
outputs: Separate historical progress snapshots from final active state
criteria: Use verified 24 endpoints and complete final inventory
At most two existing insufficient-evidence comparators for targeted genealogy review; no broad archaeology
Missing comparator evidence does not block independent work

stages.task: Diagnose errors from existing predictions and authorized metadata
outputs: Paired sequence/fold/bucket matrix for H8/H16 and registered C0 contrasts
Sign, crucial, capping, escape and coverage audit
Error episodes for all nine sequences with explicit focus on OBneIVg4Cw
criteria: Keep all queries and registered masses
Distinguish observations from hypotheses
Do not retune thresholds, select checkpoints, remove difficult sequences or change the campaign decision
Mark all new breakdowns as post hoc descriptive

stages.task: Specify and admit a bounded matched cost protocol
outputs: Protocol for the nine frozen heads and their real producer routes
criteria: Reuse the 64 TRAIN fold0 queries selected by the registered hash; no targets or error selection
CPU FP32 heads, four numerical threads and historical interop policy
Check timer scope, backend, shapes, warmup and thread counts before attributing timing differences to host load
Three prospective measurement blocks; model order balanced deterministically before measurements
Keep 25 warmups and 500 batch1 head measurements per model and block; do not repeat until a favorable result
Freeze full-route repetitions and stop boundary before raw access

stages.task: Measure real context and producer cost under an explicit exclusive slot
outputs: Per-query total latency and stage timing
Memory, producer-call counts, availability and route-dependency receipts
criteria: Explicit exclusive GPU/heavy-I/O slot from shared owner; do not stop Stage70-76
Verify raw TRAIN and frozen producer weights via existing manifests before executing
Measure raw slice/ROI, experts, feature construction, head and TTC output
Measure total request time directly; do not add stage p95 values or divide batch throughput into response latency
A5+PAIR shares A5; excluded experts must not affect validity, history, anchors or normalization
Do not assume retrospective current-ROI context is cached between different queries
If independent reduced route cannot be verified, report it as unavailable instead of fabricating an online equivalent

Define timing boundaries explicitly: if ROI is supplied externally or by the dataset, report estimator latency conditional on an available ROI; do not claim that detector, persistent tracking or sensor-to-AEB cost was measured.

If a frozen producer uses GPU, synchronize the measured execution and record transfers; preserve its recorded numerical/runtime contract rather than introducing a faster precision or backend as an unregistered alternative.

stages.task: Make the frozen-system decision without changing prior statistical gates
outputs: Accuracy/cost frontier with scope and uncertainty
H8 versus H16 recommendation conditional on measured whole-route cost
criteria: Keep H8 as historical candidate
H16 is the accuracy challenger, not automatically promoted
No reduced or aggregation arm currently passes the registered accuracy screen; lower measured latency alone cannot reverse that result
If no application latency budget exists, publish the tradeoff without inventing one
End the study once planned outputs or concrete blockers are established

single_next_study.external_dependency: Explicit exclusive GPU/heavy-I/O lease plus verified authorized raw TRAIN sources and existing frozen producer weights

subsequent_decision_only.condition: Only after frozen-system cost and failure characterization
subsequent_decision_only.direction: If the objective becomes independent generalization, design one separately authorized confirmatory evaluation on genuinely independent scenes; determine comparators, practical margin, population and statistical unit before seeing outcomes.
subsequent_decision_only.why_not_more_head_seeds_now: The paired head-seed improvement is stable; the larger remaining uncertainties concern scenes, shared frozen experts, information availability and system cost.
